open_questions: Recover dated returns for Dupont’s fighting column and Reding/Goupigny’s engaged divisions; do not import the later surrender counts.
Deferred: the dated original returns and reports identified above, and any deeper source-lineage reconciliation. No additional research cycle follows merely from this gap.

Source dependence: Bodart is a later compilation. Toreno, Foy, Oman, Saint-Cyr and the official Correspondance are interested or retrospective source families, and embedded/reprinted reports are not extra independent witnesses. Agreement does not establish independence.

A.strength_population_and_time: Bodart’s engagement-level available force; no dated opening return. Source-specific alternatives below retain their own moment and population. Alternatives/limits: Foy gives Dupont personal direction of the 2,600 combatants preceding the baggage; Barbou followed with the rear portion.
A.command_scope: Printed side-A commander Dupont; local/superior authority and transitions remain limited to the additional passages cited below. Foy places Dupont with the leading 2,600 combatants and Barbou with the rear portion behind the baggage.
A.army_continuity: Unknown: these passages do not establish a cross-engagement army identity.

B.strength_population_and_time: Bodart’s engagement-level available force; no dated opening return. Civilians, recruits, regular troops and surrender survivors are not interchangeable. Alternatives/limits: Toreno records 2,000 cavalry in the organized Andalusian army before its July advance.
B.command_scope: Printed side-B commander Castaños; local/superior authority and transitions remain limited to the additional passages cited below. Toreno puts the two divisions on the field under Reding and Goupigny, with Goupigny subordinate to Reding.
B.army_continuity: Unknown: repeated names and formation labels do not establish continuity.
